status: separate extension to the frozen core input contract; descriptive no-fit join

added_columns.same_starts: overall same-distance start count within the past query range represented in the saved feature table; not a complete lifetime census
added_columns.same_valid_times: overall valid same-distance time count within the past query range represented in the saved feature table; not a complete lifetime census
added_columns.same_distance_last5_actual_n: bounded support count among most recent five actual-history slots
added_columns.same_distance_last5_normal_n: bounded support count among most recent five normalized-history slots

interpretation: same_starts/same_valid_times summarize the available past query range and are not complete lifetime censuses. They are not interchangeable with either bounded last-five count. These existing saved columns do not establish publication-time availability beyond the feature source's historical construction contract.
join_scope: exact 17,412 target runners and 1,779 race cohort; no extrapolation to omitted historical rows
